explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 4.1 / 5.2.1, Trust Deed for Cat III AIF Trust is registered under the Registration Act, 1908. The Trap: Other acts apply to different legal entities. Cross-Exam Context: Fundamental legal structuring point. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Keep a certified copy of the registered Trust Deed in the fund's legal file.
